name: std::linear_congruential_engine<UIntType,a,c,m>::seed
intro:
Sets the state of the random-number engine.

1) Right after the state is set, *this == std::linear_congruential_engine(value) is true.

2) Right after the state is set, *this == std::linear_congruential_engine(seq) is true.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
value

 -

 seed value to use to set the state


 seq

 -

 seed sequence to use to set the state

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: 2) If SeedSeq is not std::seed_seq, throws the exceptions thrown by the seq.generate call.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text:
1) Same as std::linear_congruential_engine(value).

2) Same as std::linear_congruential_engine(seq).

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Two engines start with seed 42. Advancing one by discard(3) matches three calls to the other.

summary: Sets the state of the random-number engine.
